content_html:
Programmatic-SEO (pSEO) static site generator for astrology content. Generates 21,000+ unique, SEO-optimized static HTML pages — daily horoscopes, zodiac guides, planetary aspects, transits, and house pages — with real ephemeris data computed via Swiss Ephemeris (Moshier fallback), requiring no ephemeris data files.

Built to power tianji-astrology.com — AI astrology readings & birth charts.

What it does

  • Daily horoscopes for all 12 zodiac signs, regenerated per UTC date, with live ephemeris blocks (Moon sign, retrogrades, ingresses).
  • Zodiac guides, aspect pages, transit pages (planet-in-sign per year), and house pages — a full pSEO content matrix.
  • Every page ships: unique <title>/meta description/canonical URL, JSON-LD structured data, reviewed_at timestamps, computed whole-sign-house data, and internal related links.
  • Emits a full sitemap.xml.
  • Zero-CJK output gate: hard-fails the build if any non-ASCII leaks into HTML.
  • Pure Python stdlib + pyswisseph — deterministic, fast, offline.

Usage

pip install pyswisseph

# Generate today's 12 daily horoscope pages + refresh sitemap
python3 tj_pseo_gen.py daily --out ./dist --date "$(date -u +%F)"

# Generate a batch of additional content pages (guides → aspects → transits)
python3 tj_pseo_gen.py batch --out ./dist --n 40

Serve the output directory with any static file server and point your sitemap at it. See RUNBOOK.md for operational details (categories, URL prefixes, deployment notes).

Page categories

Prefix Pattern Content
/horoscopes/ daily-horoscope-<sign>-<date>.html 12 daily horoscopes per UTC day
/guides/ <planet>-<sign>-guide.html Planet-in-sign guides
/aspects/ <p1>-<p2>-<aspect>.html Aspect interpretation pages
/transits/ <planet>-in-<sign>-<year>.html Ingress/retrograde key dates
/houses/ house pages House meanings
